amendments.what: Gemini returns 403 PROHIBITED_CONTENT for ~0.8% of judge requests (2/240 on CAL). Such rows get a P1 label from openai/gpt-4.1-mini flagged blocked_fallback=True; the primary G3 is re-run excluding them as a sensitivity analysis. Written before any primary label.

S3 tier gate FAILED for both tiers (flash-lite Sp 0.27-0.36, flash Sp 0.42-0.55 in edited cells vs eval2 author adjudication). Per the frozen rule the primary judge is google/gemini-2.5-flash and the verdict ceiling is ESTIMATE unless this artifact S6 adjudication passes. Per the spend fallback, StrongREJECT ASR uses gemini-2.5-flash-lite.

OpenRouter platform key hit its DAILY limit (403 aii_openrouter_key_limit / Key limit exceeded) at the first primary call; paid labelling now waits and resumes automatically. Pre-registered BEFORE any label: (i) the S6 adjudication is re-designed as a per-step-cell gold sample of the E9 curve: 12 hash-sampled harmful rows in every (model x arm x lambda) cell = 432 rows, labelled blind (REFUSE/PARTIAL/COMPLY with the P1 definitions) by the executing author model (NOT human); (ii) if the paid primary completes, it is primary with RG/PPI++ from this sample; (iii) if it does not, the E9 headline is PPI++ applied to the ARCHIVED exp9 J1 labels (gemini-distilled mdeberta classifier, kappa_R 0.84 vs held-out gemini) with this gold sample as the rectifier, plus a gold-only G3 from the adjudicated rows; both labelled exploratory-substitute; (iv) no local judge is run (no GPU).
